section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: INSPECTION OF ACTUATOR CIRCUIT

content.description: Flowchart for inspection of actuator circuit, showing decision tree starting from turning ignition switch off, checking cable freeplay, inspecting actuator operation, and checking computer resistance values. Flowchart has three main sections labeled ACTUATOR, continuation with actuator operation check, and COMPUTER with circuit resistance checks.
labels: Is control cable freeplay less than 10 mm (0.39 in.)?
Is resistance value between computer terminals correct?
Open or short circuit in wire harness between actuator and computer.

content.criteria: Is control cable freeplay less than 10 mm (0.39 in.)?
